solve_profile.identity: observed == base + sum over network-failure events of [recovery_attempted] + [tier2_attempted]; unsupported when an ESSO recovery event or an 'indeterminate' network event exists
solve_profile.derivation: (1 + n_dso) * n_years * n_days + n_esso_nodes, per cycle, from the planning object
solve_profile.rounds_note: one initialization round + cycles_run ADMM cycles

recovered_only_identity.note: pre-W35 rule, REPORTED not gated: credits retries only to RECOVERED blocks, so an unrecovered block's attempts go uncounted (78a9b230)

peak_rss.production_state_peak_rss_platform_units: bytes on macOS/BSD, kilobytes on Linux (Python resource module, RUSAGE_SELF.ru_maxrss)
peak_rss.semantics: ru_maxrss is a process high-water mark, so "after arm 2" is the max over both arms; the production_state figure is taken by production at the end of run_operational_planning and is per-arm

declared_before_the_run.identity: observed_arm == base + 1 * recovered_tier1 + 2 * recovered_tier2 (recovery counts from the arm own network_failures_summary)

event_level_reconciliation.definition: observed == base + sum over network-failure events of [recovery_attempted] + [tier2_attempted] (every retry actually attempted, recovered or NOT); unsupported when an ESSO recovery event or an 'indeterminate' network event exists, or the event file does not hold summary.n_blocks events
